verses.1: And the LORD said to Noah, “Go out with all your household to the ark. For I have seen you as a righteous person in this world.”
verses.2: From all the clean animals, you shall take seven males and their wives. From the unclean animals, you shall take two males and their wives.
verses.3: And from the heavens, seven males and seven females were sent to sow the seeds on all the land.
verses.4: For in those days, seven times, I will rain forty days and forty nights over the earth. Then I will destroy all that I have created on this land.
verses.5: And Noah did all that Jehovah commanded him.
verses.6: And Noah was born when he was six hundred years old. The flood covered the entire earth with water.
verses.7: And Noah and his sons, along with his wife and their families, went with him to the ark, away from the waters of the flood.
verses.8: From the pure animals, and from the animals that are not pure. And from the birds, and from everything that crawls on the ground.
verses.9: Two, two, they came to Noah. A male and a female, just as God commanded Noah.
verses.10: And in those seven days, there was a flood on the earth.
verses.11: In the year of six hundred years from Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, all the clouds in the sky were torn apart, and the heavens opened.
verses.12: And it rained on the earth for forty days and forty nights.
verses.13: On this day, Noah and his sons, along with his wife and three of his daughters, were sent to the ark.
verses.14: And all kinds of animals, and all kinds of birds, and all kinds of insects that live on the earth, and all kinds of insects that fly in the air. All kinds of butterflies, and all kinds of bees.
verses.15: And they came to Noah’s ark, to the ark that contained two of every kind of animal, so that there might be living souls in it.
verses.16: And the male and female animals from all kinds of livestock came, just as God had commanded. And Jehovah sealed them with a seal.
verses.17: And the flood lasted for forty days over the land. The waters rose, and they covered the land completely.
verses.18: And the waters rose, and they became extremely abundant on the land. And the frogs spread out upon the surface of the water.
verses.19: And the waters rose greatly above the land. They covered all the high mountains that were beneath the entire sky.
verses.20: Fifteen miles above, the waters rose and covered the mountains.
verses.21: And every living creature on the earth was destroyed: birds, animals, and all kinds of creatures that lived on the earth. And all people too were destroyed.
verses.22: All that have a living spirit within them, they die in their own bodies. All that are destroyed, they perish.
verses.23: And He destroyed all those creatures that lived on the earth, from humans to animals, down to insects and even birds in the sky. He destroyed them from the land, except for Noah and his family.
verses.24: And the waters rose over the land for fifty days.
